# Outcome
Make Systems, Focus and Node editor read one contributor-owned model admitted through the running relational engine.

## Serial delivery
After the nested execution package's final review: define the Systems contribution/admission approach → review the approach → define ownership and compiler contracts → define enforcement cases → review the boundary and cases → contribute source facts → admit them → review admission evidence → switch views and remove the old path → review cutover.

## Criteria
Each fact has one declared owner. Separate package identity, System identity, declared dependencies, observed imports and authored semantic dependencies. Demonstrate compile-time rejection of invalid boundary access and runtime rejection of invalid facts and scopes. Preserve source coverage and view behavior. Remove the predecessor path completely during cutover.

## Decisions
The child proposal resolves System/package identity and ownership for review; this overall plan does not pre-approve those architectural choices.
properties.title: Complete contributor-owned models and Systems inspection
